reason: Replace the rejected consecutive-ANOMALY persistence rule with confirmation on the first causally evaluated window that shares no observations with the first indication window.

new_rule.name: FIRST_INDICATION_FULL_WINDOW_REFRESH
new_rule.first_indication: The first ANOMALY while SEARCHING starts one non-overlapping verification candidate at window k.
new_rule.mathematical_basis: window_samples / stride_samples = 20 / 5 = 4; window k+4 shares zero observations with window k.
new_rule.failed_verification: If decision(k+4) != ANOMALY, record VERIFICATION_FAILED and resume SEARCHING at k+5.
new_rule.concurrency: No concurrent or overlapping verification candidates.
new_rule.target_early_stop: After CONFIRMED_DETECTION, LLM inference for that TARGET simulationRun may stop.
new_rule.normal_holdout: Early stop is prohibited; every planned window must be evaluated. Every ANOMALY is counted as a false-alarm opportunity; no target confirmation rule is imposed on normal data.
new_rule.end_of_trajectory: Preserve FIRST_INDICATION and record VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE_END_OF_TRAJECTORY when k+4 does not exist.
new_rule.no_anomaly: Record NO_DETECTION after the complete TARGET trajectory.

hypothesis_impact.H1: TARGET detection rate and no-detection status use CONFIRMED_DETECTION, not consecutive persistence. NORMAL HOLDOUT false alarms count every ANOMALY over the complete trajectory without early stop.
hypothesis_impact.H2: First indication remains descriptive; confirmed alarm and delay are anchored to k+4. EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT remains abstention.
hypothesis_impact.H3: Evidence coherence rules and thresholds are unchanged; aggregation stops at the confirmed TARGET window when early stop applies.
